description: A country's averages are the mean of per-race averages, so each race counts equally.

d.request: For each circuit country, calculate the mean of the average constructor standings points and wins per race held in that country (where each race counts equally regardless of how many constructors competed), and report how far each country's mean wins is above or below the overall mean of all countries' mean wins.
d.sql: WITH race_country_averages AS (SELECT c.country, r.raceId, AVG(cs.points) as avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) as avg_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId JOIN constructorStandings cs ON r.raceId = cs.raceId GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId), country_means AS (SELECT country, AVG(avg_points) as mean_avg_points, AVG(avg_wins) as mean_avg_wins FROM race_country_averages GROUP BY country), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(mean_avg_wins) as overall_mean_wins FROM country_means) SELECT cm.country, cm.mean_avg_points, cm.mean_avg_wins, cm.mean_avg_wins - om.overall_mean_wins as wins_diff_from_overall_mean FROM country_means cm CROSS JOIN overall_mean om ORDER BY cm.country

a.request: For each circuit country, average the constructors' stored season-to-date points (`constructorStandings.points`) and season-to-date wins (`constructorStandings.wins`), first within each race held there and then across those per-race figures, so each race counts equally (ignoring missing values). Return every country with its average points, its average wins, and its average wins minus the simple mean of all countries' average wins (each country counted once), without rounding.
a.sql:
WITH race_country_standings AS (
  SELECT 
    c.country,
    r.raceId,
    AVG(cs.points) as race_avg_points,
    AVG(cs.wins) as race_avg_wins
  FROM constructorStandings cs
  JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId
),
country_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    country,
    AVG(race_avg_points) as avg_points,
    AVG(race_avg_wins) as avg_wins
  FROM race_country_standings
  GROUP BY country
),
global_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as global_avg_wins
  FROM country_averages
)
SELECT 
  ca.country,
  ca.avg_points,
  ca.avg_wins,
  ca.avg_wins - gm.global_avg_wins as wins_diff
FROM country_averages ca
CROSS JOIN global_mean gm
ORDER BY ca.country

b.request: For each circuit country, calculate the average constructor standings points and wins across all races held there, and compute the deviation of each country's average wins from the mean of all countries' average wins.
b.sql: WITH country_stats AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.points) as avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) as avg_wins FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId JOIN constructorStandings cs ON r.raceId = cs.raceId GROUP BY c.country), mean_wins AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as mean_wins FROM country_stats) SELECT cs.country, cs.avg_points, cs.avg_wins, cs.avg_wins - mw.mean_wins as wins_deviation FROM country_stats cs CROSS JOIN mean_wins mw ORDER BY cs.country
b.raw: For each circuit country, calculate the average constructor standings points and wins across all races held there, and compute the deviation of each country's average wins from the mean of all countries' average wins.

c.request: For each circuit country, what are the average constructor standings points and wins (the season-to-date figures) at races held there? Also, how far is each country's average wins above or below the average of the country figures? A country's averages are the mean of per-race averages, so each race counts equally.
c.sql:
WITH race_country_stats AS (
  SELECT c.country, r.raceId, AVG(cs.points) as avg_race_points, AVG(cs.wins) as avg_race_wins
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  JOIN constructorStandings cs ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
  GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId
),
country_averages AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(avg_race_points) as avg_constructor_points, AVG(avg_race_wins) as avg_constructor_wins
  FROM race_country_stats
  GROUP BY country
),
overall_wins_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_constructor_wins) as overall_avg_wins
  FROM country_averages
)
SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_constructor_points, ca.avg_constructor_wins, ca.avg_constructor_wins - owa.overall_avg_wins as wins_diff_from_overall
FROM country_averages ca
CROSS JOIN overall_wins_average owa
ORDER BY ca.country
